1.consolidated_definition: Thouinia portoricensis, familia de las sapindáceas. Es arbusto que alcanza quince pies de altura, con tronco de tres pulgadas de diámetro, corteza color castaño, hojas elípticas, flores blancuzcas que se producen en racimos y frutos vellosos, pequeño, de una sola semilla. Crece en el sudoeste de la Isla. También quiebrahacha.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Thouinia portoricensis, Sapindaceae family. A shrub that reaches a height of 15 feet, with a trunk diameter of three inches, brownish bark, elliptical leaves, white flowers produced in clusters and hairy fruits, small, containing a single seed. It grows in the southwestern part of the Island. Also known as quebrahacha.
